title: Laptop left on a train

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: Left my laptop on the train

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
I left my work laptop on the 18:05 from Leeds last night. I've reported it to the rail company's lost property but no luck yet. Asset tag on the bottom is NG-LT-0207.

Tom

handling.escalation_reason: A lost device is a possible data exposure.

rationale: Lost devices are named in the security flag's definition. The disk is encrypted per the asset record and nothing suggests misuse yet, so P2 rather than P1. Any remote wipe is a person's decision.
